A plain resubmission does not come here; it uses the customer's own submit_referral in that job. When the job starts from this handoff: keep the verification already logged, and skip ask_verification through log_verification. Reuse the get_referrals and get_time results already read, and read them again only if they are missing. Take card_name from the card type on the REJECTED referral record. rules.quote: The referred business must spend at least $3,000 within 90 days of account opening for you to receive the bonus

rules.rule: Business Gold Rewards Card: $200 per referral, $7,500 within 90 from account opening (the document gives no unit), up to 8 per year. No referrals accepted after 2025-09-15.
rules.quote: The referral program accepts new referrals until 2025-09-15. Referrals submitted after this date are not eligible.

basis.clause: $7,500 within 90
basis.quote: The referred business must spend $7,500 within 90 from account opening to qualify your bonus.

basis.clause: 8 per year
basis.quote: You can earn up to 8 referral bonuses per calendar year.

rules.rule: Business Platinum Rewards Card: $300 per referral, $15,000 within 135 days, up to 11 per year.
rules.quote: When the referred business is approved and completes qualifying spend of $15,000 within 135 days from account opening, you earn a bonus of $300.

rules.rule: Green Rewards Card: 75 per referral, at least $2,250 within 90 days, up to 7 per year.
rules.quote: The referred business must spend at least $2,250 within 90 days from account opening to qualify your bonus.

rules.rule: Silver Zoom Card: $150 per referral, $7,500 within 90 days, up to 10 per year. No new referrals after 2025-10-01.
rules.quote: No new referrals are accepted after 2025-10-01

rules.rule: Silver Zoom Card bonus is $150 per referred logistics business. Claims of a different bonus or spend for this card (for example $100 for $3,000) are incorrect.
rules.quote: Earn a referral bonus of $150 for each referred logistics business that is approved and meets the qualifying spend requirement

rules.rule: Check claimed terms against the requested card's own program. Terms that belong to another card's program are still incorrect for the requested card: explain the discrepancy and give no link.
rules.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

rules.rule: Each credit card has its own referral terms, so every card the customer asks about is checked separately.
rules.quote: Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.

rules.rule: Once the limit is hit, a third or later referral within the same week is denied automatically.
rules.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single week, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals that week) will be automatically denied.

rules.rule: A new referral record starts with status NO_PROGRESS.
rules.quote: When the tool is called successfully, a referral record is created with status 'NO_PROGRESS'. The referred person can then use the generated link to apply.

rules.rule: An ERROR status means retry later.
rules.quote: ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists.

rules.rule: A REJECTED status means: do not retry immediately, and review the existing referral activity before advising.
rules.quote: REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

rules.rule: Count the rolling 7-day window from the exact timestamps of the most recent referral bonuses in get_referrals_by_user, measured back from the current time given by get_current_time. Do not use calendar weeks.
rules.quote: A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

rules.rule: An unverifiable offer from a Rho-Bank letter, email or flyer is not a reason to offer a transfer. If the customer persists and demands a human, the reason comes from the highest tier that applies: customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal (Tier 1) before unconfirmed_external_communication (Tier 2).
rules.quote: Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human

rules.rule: Choose the transfer reason from the highest tier that applies.
rules.quote: Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

done_when: For every card the customer asked about, one of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told why no referral link can be provided for that card: no documented program (re-checked once if they insisted), program closed, claimed terms incorrect (with the correct documented terms stated), or the referral would be auto-rejected. No tool was given for that card, no document was requested, and no transfer was offered. A transfer happened only if the customer persisted and demanded a human, using the highest-tier reason code. (b) The customer is verified and logged, has been given get_referral_link, has run it successfully with their own user_id and the exact card name, and has heard the correct documented terms.
